description: Static reference of 13 known AI crawlers and control tokens (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended...): owner, purpose, whether each drives AI citations or training, plus rules of thumb. Use to decide which bots to allow or block. No site is fetched. Do NOT use to audit a real site (use check_ai_readiness) or to produce rules (use robots_txt_for_ai).
name: crawler_policy_guide

want_ai_visibility.description: Bots to keep allowed for AI search/citations.

crawlers.description: Reference row per known AI crawler or control token.

title: Crawler policy guide
